Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১) Choose the synonym of “Knackered”:
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: ক) Exhausted.

• Knackered: (adjective)
English Meaning: extremely tired
Bangla Meaning: অত্যন্ত ক্লান্ত।

• Given Options:

ক) Exhausted (adjective)
English Meaning: very tired
Bangla Meaning: ক্লান্ত; অবসন্ন।

খ) Vigorous (adjective)
English Meaning: very active, determined or full of energy
Bangla Meaning: বলিষ্ঠ; তেজস্বী; বলবান; প্রবল; তেজীয়ান।

গ) Restorative (adjective)
English Meaning: helping you to become healthy or strong again
Bangla Meaning: আরোগ্যকারী; শক্তিবর্ধক।

ঘ) Energetic (adjective)
English Meaning: having or needing a lot of energy
Bangla Meaning: প্রাণবন্ত; উদ্যমী।

অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায়, the synonym of “Knackered” - Exhausted.

----------

More synonyms: Fatigued, Weary.

Source: Accessible & Oxford Dictionary.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
৫) Choose the best replacement for the underlined part:
The committee recommended that every applicant submits the form before Friday.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: খ) submit.

Correct Sentence: The committee recommended that every applicant submit the form before Friday.

• recommend that এর পরে সাধারণত subjunctive mood ব্যবহৃত হয়। 
- তাই that-clause-এ verb-এর base form বসে।

গঠন:
recommend that + subject + verb-এর base form.

• এটি Subjunctive Mood এর নিয়ম। কিছু নির্দিষ্ট verb এর পরে that clause এ সবসময় base form of verb (be/do/go ইত্যাদি) ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

• Subjunctive Rule: কিছু verb যেমন- desire, ask, demand, insist, suggest, prefer, propose, recommend ইত্যাদির পর পরবর্তী clause এ s/es/ing/ed বিহীন verb ব্যবহৃত হয়, এরূপ verb কে বলে Subjunctive.
Structure: Subject+ Subjunctive verb + that + পরবর্তী verb এর base form বসে।
- তাই এখানে base form 'submit' বসবে।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) What is the meaning of the word “Kudos”?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: A desire to control other people
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The meaning of the word “Kudos” is - Praise given for achievement.

• Kudos (Noun):
- English Meaning: the praise and honour that goes with a particular achievement or position
- Bangla Meaning: (কথ্য) সম্মান ও গৌরব।

• Example Sentence:
- She received kudos for her excellent performance.
- The team earned kudos for completing the project early.

Source: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) What is the meaning of the word “Lithe”?
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option3: Moving or bending easily, in a way that is attractive
Bank-Daily-Quiz.option4: Unable to move because of illness
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
• The meaning of the word “Lithe” is - Moving or bending easily, in a way that is attractive.

• Lithe (Adjective):
- English Meaning: (of a person or their body) moving or bending easily, in a way that is attractive
- Bangla Meaning: (ব্যক্তি অথবা শরীরের ক্ষেত্রে) নমনীয়; সহজে নড়াচড়া করা যায় এমন।

• Example Sentence:
- The dancer had a lithe and graceful body.
- Her lithe movements impressed the audience.

Source: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary, Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
৮) Choose the best replacement for the underlined part:
Neither the manager nor the employees was willing to accept the proposal.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: খ) were.

Correct Sentence: Neither the manager nor the employees were willing to accept the proposal.
- Neither...nor যুক্ত subject-এর ক্ষেত্রে verb নিকটবর্তী subject অনুযায়ী হয়। এখানে employees plural, তাই were হবে।

• Neither .... nor দ্বারা দুইটা Noun/Pronoun যুক্ত হলে শেষের noun/pronoun অনুযায়ী verb বসে।
 
• [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + singular noun + singular verb.
- Neither the salesmen nor the marketing manager is in favor of the system.
 
• [Either/neither] + noun + [or/nor] + plural noun + plural verb.
- Neither John nor his friends are going to the beach today.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) Find the correctly spelled word.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: খ) Libellous.

• Libellous (adjective)
English Meaning: containing a libel about somebody
Bangla Meaning: কুৎসাপূর্ণ, কুৎসাজনক: a libellous journal/article.

Example:
The editor removed the libellous allegation before publication.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) Find the correctly spelled word.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: গ) Klaxon.

• Klaxon (noun)
English Meaning: a horn, originally on a vehicle, that makes a loud sound as a warning
Bangla Meaning: মোটরগাড়ির বিদ্যুৎচালিত হর্ন বা ভেঁপু।

Example:
The klaxon sounded before the emergency drill began.

Source: Oxford Learner’s Dictionary; Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
১১) Choose the best replacement for the underlined part:
Not only she apologized, but she also offered to pay for the damage.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: ক) did she apologize.

Correct Sentence: Not only did she apologize, but she also offered to pay for the damage.

• বাক্যের শুরুতে Not only বসলে পরের clause-এ সাধারণত inversion হয়। অর্থাৎ auxiliary verb আগে বসে, তারপর subject বসে।

গঠন:
Not only + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb

এখানে মূল verb হলো apologize, তাই auxiliary verb did ব্যবহৃত হবে।

অন্যান্য অপশন:

খ) she did apologize — এখানে inversion হয়নি, তাই ভুল।

গ) had she apologized — past perfect-এর প্রয়োজন নেই।

ঘ) No improvement — মূল বাক্যটি ভুল।

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question:
১২) Choose the best replacement for the underlined part:
The teacher made the students to rewrite the assignment.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: খ) rewrite.

Correct Sentence: The teacher made the students rewrite the assignment.

Make-এর পরে object থাকলে verb-এর base form ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- তাই made the students rewrite হবে।

• Causative Verb হিসাবে 'Make' -এর ব্যবহার:
- Make এরপরে কোনো ব্যক্তি বা বস্তু (Action doer) থাকলে এরপরে verb -এর base form বসে।
- কাউকে কোনো কিছু করতে বাধ্য করা অর্থে Causative Verb হিসাবে Make ব্যবহার করা হয়।

• Structure: Subject + make (any tense) + action doer + verb -এর base form + ext.

• More examples:
- She made me wait for an hour.
- My friend made me try the new restaurant.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৩) Had I known about the meeting, I ________ it.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: খ) would have attended.

• 3rd Conditional এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- If clause- এ যদি (had + V3) হয়, তবে পরবর্তী clause a would/could/might + have + V3 + extension ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- Conditional sentence এ Had + Sub + V3 + Extension এভাবে কোন sentence শুরু হলে সেটি Perfect conditional / 3rd conditional হয়।

Complete Sentence: Had I known about the meeting, I would have attended it.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) Fill in the blanks: Only when ______ failed, the police resorted to _____
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
[United Commercial Bank PLC. Post Name: Probationary Officer]

সঠিক উত্তর: গ) persuasions, force.

Options,

ক)
efforts:
English meaning: an attempt to do something especially when it is difficult to do.
Bangla meaning: প্রচেষ্টা; প্রয়াস।

power:
English meaning: the ability to control people or things.
Bangla meaning: শক্তি; ক্ষমতা।

খ)
arrests:
English meaning: If the police arrest someone, they take them away to ask them about a crime that they might have committed.
Bangla meaning: গ্রেপ্তার; আটক।

imprisonment:
English meaning: the act of putting someone in prison or the condition of being kept in prison.
Bangla meaning: কারাদণ্ড; কারাবাস।

গ)
persuasions:
English meaning: the action of persuading someone or of being persuaded.
Bangla meaning: প্ররোচনা বা প্ররোচিতকরণ; প্ররোচনার ক্ষমতা।

force:
English meaning: physical, especially violent, strength or power.
Bangla meaning: বল; শক্তি; বলপ্রয়োগ।

ঘ)
power:
English meaning: the ability to control people or things.
Bangla meaning: শক্তি; ক্ষমতা।

punishment:
English meaning: the act of punishing someone.
Bangla meaning: শাস্তি; দণ্ড।

অপশন বিবেচনা করে দেখা যায়, শূন্যস্থান দুটিতে যথাক্রমে persuasions এবং force বসালে বাক্যটি অর্থপূর্ণ হয়। অর্থাৎ, বোঝানোর চেষ্টা ব্যর্থ হওয়ার পরই পুলিশ বলপ্রয়োগের আশ্রয় নিয়েছিল।

Complete sentence: Only when persuasions failed, the police resorted to force.

Source: Accessible Dictionary.

Bank-Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) Complete the sentence with an appropriate preposition: She has always been indifferent ________ public criticism.
Bank-Daily-Quiz.exp:
সঠিক উত্তর: খ) to.

Complete sentence: She has always been indifferent to public criticism.

• Indifferent (to somebody/something)
English meaning: having or showing no interest in somebody/something.
Bangla meaning: নিঃস্পৃহ; অনীহ; উদাসীন; নিরুৎসুক। 

Example: 
- He is indifferent to the sufferings of his parents.
- It is indifferent to him whether she comes back or not.
 
Source: Oxford Dictionary.
